subject.title: fix: allow configuring Slack App Home copy

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new Slack `appHome` config surface for branded Home copy and disabling Home publishing, or should this PR be narrowed to the slash-command fallback copy mismatch only?
rationale: The implementation is plausibly in the Slack plugin owner boundary, but new operator config and SDK contract surface are product- and compatibility-sensitive and cannot be settled by CI alone.

options.title: Approve bounded appHome config
options.body: Accept the new Slack config surface after the Block Kit limit finding is fixed and redacted real Slack proof demonstrates configured copy plus disabled publishing.

options.title: Narrow to fallback copy
options.body: Remove the new config block and only make the default Home description honor the configured slash command name.

options.title: Defer Home customization policy
options.body: Pause or close this PR until maintainers choose a broader Slack Home customization or plugin API direction.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded appHome config
recommendation.body: Accept the new Slack config surface after the Block Kit limit finding is fixed and redacted real Slack proof demonstrates configured copy plus disabled publishing.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the merged base Slack App Home implementation and is the clearest routing candidate for expanding that surface.
